sources.snippet: The OpenAI webserver follows closely samosa-chat, a Qwen3.6-35b colibrì-style inference engine. It runs the model, quantized or unquantized, on very RAM-constrained systems: it works fine on a Mac with 8 GB of RAM while doing other things, and on older Intel Macs. Gemma-4 26B-A4B is ~25 B params of which only ~3.8 B activate per token.
